act.asked: Request sent: the person must confirm it within 48 hours. Nothing is done before.
act.done: Done. The person has been told.
admin.duplicate: same case number declared several times
admin.examine: Examine the decision outside the platform (original, certified copy or confirmation by the registry). Do not receive it through this service. Correct below what differs from the declaration.
admin.intro: A representative (guardian, curator, authorised person, agent) has declared a decision of the judge. Nothing is opened before your verification. The decision is never received or kept by the platform, and goes through no AI.
admin.note: Note (10 to 500 characters, without copying the decision) — the person reads it
admin.special: No end date: the link will be valid for {{days}} days, then a new verification will be needed (proposed duration, to be approved).
admin.title: Legal protection: verification of decisions
admin.verified: Decision verified: the link is active until its end date.
assist.code: The 8-digit code they show you (“Legal protection” page of their account)
assist.role: My guardian, curator or representative appointed by the judge
declare.court: Court (for example: tribunal judiciaire de Strasbourg)
declare.done: Declaration recorded. If the address is that of the protected person’s account, they will see it. The administrator will contact you to examine the decision. No access is opened before.
declare.email: E-mail address of the protected person’s account
declare.end: End date of the measure (written in the decision)
declare.mode: The decision gives you the task of
declare.no_file: Do not send the decision here. The administrator will contact you to examine it. Only the information below is kept.
declare.password: Your password (to confirm that it is you)
declare.ref: Case number at the court (optional — it is not kept in readable form)
declare.representation: representing the person (acting in their place)
declare.siret: SIRET of your service or activity (optional)
declare.title: Declare a decision of the judge
declare.truthful: I certify that this decision exists, that it appoints me and that it is current. A false declaration ends the link and can lead to the suspension of my account.
err.area: The verified decision does not cover this part.
err.end_date_beyond_law: This end date exceeds the duration the law allows for this measure: check it in the decision.
err.kind_not_allowed: A family authorisation (habilitation familiale) can only be given to a relative of the person.
err.measure_ended: According to its end date, this measure has ended: it cannot be recorded.
err.not_active: This link is not active (not verified yet, suspended, ended or expired): nothing was done.
err.not_installed: Legal protection is not available on this service yet. Nothing has been recorded.
err.rep_code: The representative’s code is not valid, or their link is not verified. Ask them for a new code.
err.rep_required: A verified court decision gives your representative the task of acting for you here: the assisted mode is only possible with them. You can always use your account yourself.
err.statement: Tick the box certifying that the judge’s decision exists and appoints you.
event.reinstated: link restored after the report was examined
falc.1: A judge can choose a person to protect you.
falc.2: This person is called: guardian (tuteur), curator (curateur), authorised person or agent (mandataire).
falc.3: Here, you see who protects you, what this person can do for you, and until when.
falc.4: You always keep your account. You can always use it yourself.
falc.5: Everything this person does here is written down. You can read it.
falc.6: Nothing opens before the administrator has checked the judge’s decision.
form.prepose: Agent employed by an establishment (préposé d’établissement)
kind.mjpm: A court-appointed adult protection agent (mandataire judiciaire à la protection des majeurs, MJPM)
login_required: Sign in to see this page.
measure.hf_speciale: Special family authorisation, for certain acts (habilitation familiale spéciale)
measure.sauvegarde: Safeguard of justice with a special mandate (sauvegarde de justice, mandat spécial)
notif.declared: Someone says they are your guardian, curator or representative appointed by a judge. This is not verified yet. Have a look and tell us if you do not recognise them.
notif.request: Your curator or representative asks you to confirm an action. Nothing is done without your agreement.
person.contest: I do not recognise this person, or I do not agree
person.contest_confirm: The administrator will check. Meanwhile, this person can no longer do anything here. Continue?
person.contest_sent: Your report has been sent to the administrator.
person.none: Nobody is recorded as your guardian, curator or representative.
person.title: The people who protect me
power.act: Can act for you here (cancel an appointment, change the state of a step). You are told about everything they do.
power.confirm: Can look and ASK you for an action. Nothing is done without your agreement.
rep.act: You can act in the covered parts; the person is told about each action.
rep.code_value: Code to give to the person, next to them: {{code}} (valid until {{time}}).
rep.confirm: You can look and ask; the person confirms each action.
rep.hidden: Some sensitive steps are not shown to you.
rep.intro: You are a guardian, curator, authorised person or special agent appointed by a judge. You act from YOUR account: you never sign in to the person’s account. They see everything you look at and do.
rep.renounced: Link ended on this service. The measure itself only ends by a decision of the judge.
rep.title: I protect a person
req.parcours_status: set the step “{{title}}” to the state “{{status}}”
requests.title: Requests to confirm
state.declared: Declared, not verified yet: no access
state.rejected: Refused: the decision could not be verified
state.suspended: Suspended after your report: no access
